newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - July 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - July 3.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Thursday's Daily Variety:
* Seagram Co Ltd's Universal Studios will cut back plans for a destination resort on its Universal City property
* Mel Gibson, due out July 25 in "Conspiracy Theory," is lining up his next three pictures, one of which now seems likely to be "Lethal Weapon 4" for Warner Bros.
* James Stewart died Wednesday at his Beverly Hills home at the age of 89.

* Digital TV player Sogecable has just inked a far-reaching deal with Time Warner's Warner Bros, beating out rival Telefonica to a long-term exclusive relationship with the No. 1 U.S. supplier of movies and TV shows.

* Michael Jackson, the liberal KABC radio talkshow host who has been ono the air for more than 30 years, is being bumped out of his spot in a move inspired by Rush Limbaugh's continued dominance of the timeslot on rival KFI.
* Scott Greenstein, senior vice president of motion pictures, music, new media and publishing at Miramax Films, is leaving the specialized film powerhouse.
